entity.summary: Open-source self-custodial multichain wallet for Cardano, Bitcoin and Solana across mobile and browser-extension surfaces.
entity.notes: Current first-party Begin terms and product pages explicitly describe Begin Wallet as non-custodial/self-custodial. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Begin self-custodial multichain mobile wallet application.
products.notes: Selected mobile runtime only; Chrome extension is deferred.

events.title: Begin Wallet 2.5.0 added Solana support
events.description: Begin Wallet version 2.5.0 was released on 2026-02-23 with new Solana support and Solana swaps through Jupiter, providing a dated lifecycle event for the Begin Wallet mobile product.

evidence.title: Begin Wallet Terms of Service

evidence.title: Begin Wallet
